subject: Re: Kickoff: summary report optimization for attribution reporting
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Umar leads at 55%, Nikhil 50% on the experiment runner, Chiara 40% on synthetic data generation, Maren 20% on the dataframe plumbing for real slices.

Budget: Idris confirmed verbally that the full $120k on Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-60 is earmarked for this project, so we can plan the parameter sweeps against it.

Compute is unusual for us in that it's almost entirely CPU — Numpy/Scipy/Pandas, no accelerators. The spend is wide parallelism across slice-column configurations, and the sweeps grow combinatorially with the number of value columns, which is why the budget line matters more than a GPU reservation would.

One process note: anything touching real conversion data needs Privacy Review, and that's a 2-3 week SLA. I'd file in May, not June.

Daniela
